pr_title: roachtest: minor refactor to backup fixture code
pr_body:
While generating backup fixtures we ended up refactoring some code. This change also fixes the weekly failure seen in #113815. We have not completed regenerating fixtures but this refactor seems worth checking in in the meantime.

Fixes: #113815
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/115387)

review_comments: why do we need to specify `restoreUpToIncremental` during fixture generation?
i think the bucket name is determined by this number, so we need to specify it so that the correct `inc-count` suffix is added to the bucket name from which we will restore.

hrm, I think `numBackupsInChain` identifies the bucket:
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/691b544bbe40675b620e62a3505b8c7a32a5c825/pkg/cmd/roachtest/tests/restore.go#L688
we can try deleting this `restoreUpToIncremental`  set in a follow up

oh the String() method of `restoreUpToIncremental` confused me, but I think this is used to pick out the AOST I believe - https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/cca37917931978b791d241e877ba3f55f6cdaea3/pkg/cmd/roachtest/tests/restore.go#L701? I imagine we want all 48 incs to actually have the size of data that we claim?
ahhhh, I see. Ok no problems in your patch. Thanks for doing this!
